30 September 2019

## Circular to Intermediaries

## FAQs on the Guidelines for Securities Margin Financing Activities

The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) today issued Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) to provide guidance on compliance with the new Guidelines for Securities Margin Financing Activities which will come into effect on 4 October 2019.

The FAQs address concerns of the industry about compliance with the benchmarks set out in the guidelines and clarify the application and interpretation of some specific requirements.

A copy of the FAQs is attached to this circular. It is also available on the SFC website at www.sfc.hk under the section 'Regulatory functions - Intermediaries - Supervision FAQs - Guidelines for Securities Margin Financing Activities'.

Should you have any queries regarding the contents of this circular, please contact Ms Perla Yau at 2231 2115 or your case officer.

Intermediaries Supervision Department Intermediaries Division Securities and Futures Commission
